description:
Send a private buyer's or tenant's enquiry about one listing to the agency selling or letting it,
once the person has chosen the property and wants the agency to contact them. The agency receives
it in its CRM and replies to the person directly. This is the only way to contact a listing agency:
no tool returns an agency's phone or email.

Consent is required. First call get_enquiry_consent for the listing and show the person its
consent_text (it names the agency and PropertyList and says what is passed on). Only when they
clearly agree, call this with consent: true. Without consent: true nothing is sent and the consent
text comes back for you to ask them.

Give the listing `reference` (from search results), the person's name, an email and/or a phone
number (one is enough: pass a phone only when they give it and want a call), and their message.
Add preferred_viewing_times when they want to see it. One enquiry per person per listing in 30 days:
asking again adds the new message to the open enquiry. Works without an API key up to a small daily
allowance, counted per IP address, or per account for an app linked to a PropertyList account.
An enquiry cannot be recalled.

consent.description: Required, true: the person has read and agreed to the consent_text from get_enquiry_consent. Never set it on their behalf.

email.description: The person's email address. An email or a phone is required; email alone is enough.

language.description: The language the person writes in; the agency replies in it.

message.description: What they want to know or arrange, in their words.

phone.description: Optional. The person's phone number (with country code where possible), only if they give it and want a call.

preferred_viewing_times.description: Optional. When they would like to view it, in their words or as dates (e.g. 'Saturday 14 Nov morning', '2026-11-14 10:00').

reference.description: PropertyList listing reference the enquiry is about, e.g. 'PLE-12345'.

name: submit_enquiry

agency.description: The agency that has the enquiry.

enquired_on.description: already_enquired: the date of the open enquiry (YYYY-MM-DD).

title: Submit enquiry
